description: Canonical registry of 10 mechanism joint types and endpoint role semantics for MAPEOGEO v0.21

joint_types.description: Trace/contraction operation reducing tensor rank (e.g. Riemann curvature tensor to Ricci curvature tensor)
joint_types.geometric_interpretation: Algebraic trace / index contraction mapping higher-rank tensor fields to lower-rank geometric summaries

joint_types.description: Geometric evolution PDE governing deformation of metric/field tensors along energy gradients
joint_types.geometric_interpretation: Nonlinear parabolic/gradient evolution smoothing or concentrating geometric structures over time

joint_types.description: Controlled geometric cutting and capped gluing along standard neck regions to eliminate finite-time singularities
joint_types.geometric_interpretation: Excising degenerating cylindrical necks and gluing standard capped manifolds with bounded curvature and topology change control

joint_types.description: Strictly monotonic integral functional along geometric flows preventing periodic orbits and bounding entropy
joint_types.geometric_interpretation: Entropy and localized energy functionals monotonically non-decreasing along flow curves, ruling out breathers

joint_types.description: Rescaled limit of high-curvature regions modeling singularity geometry (solitons, shrinking cylinders)
joint_types.geometric_interpretation: Pointed parabolic rescaling converging to standard singularity models (e.g., S2 x R cylinders or gradient shrinking solitons)

joint_types.description: Euler-Lagrange variational correspondence between action functionals and critical geometric configurations
joint_types.geometric_interpretation: Stationary points and gradient trajectories of variational energy functionals coupling geometry to physics

joint_types.description: Stokes/Green pairing pairing topological boundaries with differential exterior derivatives (<d alpha, sigma> = <alpha, d sigma>)
joint_types.geometric_interpretation: Dual adjoint pairing between topological boundary operators on chains and exterior differential operators on cochains

joint_types.description: Orthogonal eigenspace decomposition of self-adjoint geometric/differential operators
joint_types.geometric_interpretation: Spectral theorem projection of Hilbert/Sobolev spaces into orthogonal eigenspaces of elliptic/self-adjoint operators

joint_types.description: Boundary and coboundary chain sequences satisfying d^2 = 0 and partial^2 = 0
joint_types.geometric_interpretation: Graded algebraic complex capturing topological invariants through nilpotency of sequential boundary operations

joint_types.description: Higher-dimensional manifold with boundary interpolating between disjoint source and target manifolds
joint_types.geometric_interpretation: Topological equivalence and structural transition via bounding manifold geometry
